manual.note: Standard libraries bundle battle-tested helpers so every programmer doesn’t reinvent sorting.

manual.name: The Libc Codex

manual.note: Stands for standard C library.

manual.name: AVL Balance
manual.blurb: A yellow brass balance scale on a wooden base with two level brown weighing pans suspended by grey chains.
manual.note: Stands for balanced tree structures.

manual.name: The Hourglass
manual.blurb: Measures quiet study in Libraries, guest CPU quotas in Ring −1, and frozen sand in Ring −2.
manual.note: Schedulers and hypervisors slice time into tiny grains so no single program hogs the CPU.

manual.name: Bookworm Blob
manual.blurb: A quiet scholar that hops softly between bookshelves and pauses to read footnotes.
manual.note: Shared libraries are like reference books every program borrows instead of rewriting from scratch.

manual.note: Stands for dynamic symbol resolution.

manual.name: Deferred Resolver
manual.blurb: A grey-bordered white card containing a dark grey horizontal bar over a shorter bright-yellow bar.
manual.note: Stands for lazy symbol binding.

manual.name: ELF Header Canister
manual.blurb: ELF binary format (Executable and Linkable Format). A cylindrical steel dispatch canister standing upright on a flat base, with a dark blue riveted collar band around the top and a hinged brass clasp.
manual.note: Part of the Dynamic Linker / ABI scenery.

manual.name: PLT Jump-Jack

manual.name: GOT Key-Rack

manual.name: RPATH Signpost

manual.name: ABI Caliper

manual.name: Thread Bobbin

manual.note: Stands for output spooling and streaming.

manual.name: Autoloader Cart
manual.blurb: A two-tier grey metal book trolley on spoked wheels, loaded with colourful gold-banded volumes.
manual.note: Stands for package dependency transport.

manual.name: Dot-C Crates
manual.blurb: Three stacked brown wooden shipping crates with diagonal slats, each stencilled with .C in cream lettering.
manual.note: Stands for compiled source packages.

manual.name: Linker Loom
manual.blurb: A wooden frame loom strung with vertical red and blue warp threads, a grey heddle bar, and a yellow shuttle passing across.
manual.note: Stands for linking and thread interleaving.

manual.name: Dot-A Archive

manual.note: Stands for static library archive.

manual.name: Diamond Dependency
manual.blurb: A framed dark pinboard with five pale nodes linked by crossing red, yellow, and brown threads.
manual.note: Stands for circular dependency graph.

manual.name: Manpage Lectern
manual.blurb: A wooden pedestal lectern supporting an open cream reference volume with grey text blocks on both pages.
manual.note: Stands for API reference manual.

manual.name: Deprecation Stamp
manual.blurb: A purple ink pad beside a tiered wooden rubber stamp hovering above a cream slip bearing a fresh purple impression.
manual.note: Stands for ABI version stamping.

manual.name: Locale Globe
manual.blurb: A small blue-and-green terrestrial globe mounted in a yellow brass meridian ring on a stepped wooden stand.
manual.note: Stands for internationalization and locale tables.

manual.name: The Cache Rolodex
manual.blurb: Dynamic-linker cache index (ld.so.cache). A compact rotary card index sitting on a dark wooden base, with a brass side knob and a fanned arc of cream index cards.
manual.note: Part of the Libraries scenery.

manual.name: Pkg-Config Tag
manual.blurb: pkg-config metadata tag (.pc). A chamfered cream manila shipping tag with a brass eyelet, two dark ink lines, and a red tie cord hanging from a small wall peg.
manual.note: Part of the Libraries scenery.

manual.name: ABI Wax Seal
manual.blurb: Application Binary Interface (ABI) compatibility contract. A folded cream parchment strip resting flat on the floor, pinned down by a round crimson wax seal with a raised inner ring.
manual.note: Part of the Libraries scenery.

manual.name: Bind-Time Beetle
manual.blurb: A small brown boxy creature with a yellow top ridge, two stubby grey legs underneath, and a pale-yellow plug prong extending to the right.
manual.note: Stands for dynamic linker daemon (ld.so).

manual.name: Process Skyline

manual.note: Stands for multi-process userspace cityscape.

manual.name: Init Spire
manual.blurb: A tall grey observation tower with two catwalks, yellow and cyan windows, and a glowing green beacon at its summit.
manual.note: Stands for init process (PID 1).

manual.name: Select Junction
manual.blurb: A grey horizontal pipe manifold fitted with four square sight-glass ports glowing cyan and green.
manual.note: Stands for I/O multiplexing.

manual.name: Unix Pipe

manual.note: Stands for unix anonymous pipe.

manual.name: Teletype Terminal

manual.note: Stands for teletype terminal (TTY).

manual.name: Small Ben

manual.name: Domain Socket
manual.blurb: A grey two-prong plug hovering beside a dark-grey two-hole receptacle.
manual.note: Stands for IPC socket.

manual.name: Mmap Cistern
manual.blurb: A cyan water-tower tank with a pale-cyan level window resting on a cross-braced grey steel trestle.
manual.note: Stands for POSIX shared memory.

manual.name: Signal Pennant
manual.blurb: A tall grey flagpole flying a waving two-tone red pennant.
manual.note: Stands for POSIX signals.

manual.name: Daemon Postbox
manual.blurb: Keeps its little red flag up whenever a background process has unread mail.
manual.note: Processes talk to each other through pipes, sockets, and message queues.

manual.name: Fork Signpost
manual.blurb: A grey signpost splitting into two staggered green-and-white street-name blades.
manual.note: Stands for fork() process branching.

manual.name: Syscall Booth

manual.note: Stands for syscall / emergency trap.

manual.name: Packet Firewall

manual.note: Stands for userspace firewall / packet filter.

manual.name: Shipping Container

manual.note: Stands for linux container / namespace.

manual.name: Env Tag Rack

manual.name: Syscall Gatehouse

manual.note: Stands for per-process file descriptor table (fdtable).
